competitors.title: Server-Level vs Tool-Level Authorization - Arcade Docs
key_points: Two distinct authorization layers: Resource Server auth (front-door) secures MCP server access; tool-level auth secures third-party API access
Resource Server auth validates Bearer tokens on every HTTP request; tool-level auth manages OAuth flow and token storage for external APIs
Two layers work together: Resource Server provides user identity, tool-level provides API access
stdio transport doesn't need Resource Server auth; HTTP requires it for production with auth/secrets
Arcade deploy handles server-level security automatically for cloud deployments

competitors.title: Contextual Access - Arcade Docs
key_points: Contextual Access governed by Logic Extensions with three hook points: Access Hook (tool visibility), Pre-Execution Hook (input validation/modification), Post-Execution Hook (output filtering)
Enterprises need fine-grained control over tool visibility, allowed inputs, and returned outputs
Rules run inline during tool execution with no changes to tools or agents required
Configure everything through Arcade Dashboard

competitors.title: Secure and Brand the Auth Flow in Production - Arcade Docs
key_points: User verification check on first tool authorization prevents phishing attacks
Two options: Arcade user verifier (development) vs custom user verifier (production)
Custom verifier route redirects users to your app for identity confirmation using flow_id and user_id
Arcade SDK provides auth.confirm_user method for server-side verification
Default OAuth apps only work with Arcade verifier; production apps need custom OAuth credentials

competitors.title: MCP Gateways - Arcade Docs
key_points: MCP Gateways federate tools from multiple MCP servers into a single endpoint for easier management
Three auth modes: Arcade Auth (dev), User Source with OIDC (production), Arcade Headers (fallback for non-browser clients)
Skip consent feature allows allowlisting trusted MCP client IDs to bypass OAuth consent screen
Supports Streamable HTTP transport; known client IDs for Claude, Claude Code, and VS Code
Supports selecting exactly which tools are available per gateway with server instructions

competitors.title: Audit Logs for AI Agent Platforms - Arcade Docs
key_points: Every administrative action captured automatically - who did it, how, what changed, and when
Filterable dashboard plus REST API for pulling logs into SIEM or compliance tooling
Supports cursor-based pagination with 100 req/60s rate limit
Organization-scoped and project-scoped audit log endpoints available
Supports filtering by action type, source, and resource type

competitors.title: Arcade MCP - GitHub Repository
key_points: Open-source Python framework under MIT license for building MCP servers and tools
7,500+ prebuilt tools across 81 MCP servers in Arcade.dev catalog
Decorator API with requires_auth=GitHub(scopes=['repo']) for authorized tool calling
22 helper OAuth classes for popular providers plus generic OAuth2 for custom APIs
The client and LLM never see the secret values - tokens are injected at runtime
Supports all major agent frameworks: LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents, Google ADK, Mastra
